title: What do you guys think? Is this a good trailer?
author: StarDrifterG
selftext:
hello! Want to try the game? is free

[https://stardrifterg.itch.io/city-of-gladiators](https://stardrifterg.itch.io/city-of-gladiators)

Also, what do you think about the trailer? It looks good?

Thank you!

I am using Claude Opus 5.5, GPT Sol 6 for most of the work, and a little ElevenLabs for the effects

comments.author: Jordan-Lee32
comments.body: the pixel art looks good I'd show more actual gameplay early in the trailer so people can quickly understand what makes the game fun

replies.author: Fallange19
replies.body: Exactly, the combat is so so dope

replies.author: OneMoreFightGame
replies.body: This is my thought. The trailer could be shorter and convey the same info while also hooking people with the cool looking pixel art combat up front instead.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/StarDrifterG this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.

comments.author: Rare-Package-6080
comments.body: Too slow, too samey transitions. Less text, more music and action. The game looks good and you need to show that

comments.author: CodeGuyJay
comments.body:
I feel like the text used here is an opus 5.5 favorite, and its everywhere.

The first time I saw it I thought it looked good - but the more you see the same thing, in low quality products - the more your mind starts to associate that thing with low quality products.

comments.author: derLeisemitderLaute
comments.body: sounds fun! I am a big fan of gladiator simulations. My first thought was the game "Domina". Do you control the gladiators yourself or are they controlled by AI?

replies.author: StarDrifterG
replies.body: You can choose if you want to control the gladiator or let the AI fight for you

replies.author: PossibleJealous1979
replies.body: hey du! probier gerne auch mein gladiator-management spiel. neue demo mit großem update gestern released! würd mich interessieren ob es deinen Geschmack trifft - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386380/Ludus\_Magna/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5386380/Ludus_Magna/)

comments.author: teapot_RGB_color
comments.body:
I think the trailer is quite good.

But I'm wondering what's up with the current trend of indie games adding text describing every feature you can do.

Like, I get it's coming from mobile.. it's just such a.. weird thing for me to see, does it work?

Edit : why do i need to create an account to play, how does that benefit me?

Also, can you point me to a trailer that made you personally want to buy a game, any game

replies.author: StarDrifterG
replies.body:
The account is to preserve the progress of your game on the server, and it's going to have PvP, rankings, etc..

The game is free, not pay-per-win or anything, so I'm not trying to sell you anything, I'm just trying to give you something to have fun with and to create a community that likes to enjoy  the game

comments.body: Looks like a straight up copy of Domina, though they are shitty people so not that sad about it.

comments.author: TopTippityTop
comments.body: The timing/flow is a bit strange. I think breeding horses should be towards the start, with training gladiators, or just after, abd towards the end is the culmination, showing the fights, races, etc

comments.author: DCON-creates
comments.body: I like it. Sort of game I could see myself playing

comments.author: JorgitoEstrella
comments.body: Most of the pixel art looks good except the bear and the bull they look out of place/jarring like they came from another asset pack compared to the rest of the game, that doesn't happen with the lion for example.
